import {usePlugin} from '@conciv/plugin/experimental'

export function AcmeView() {
  const ctx = usePlugin()
  const client = ctx.client
  void ctx.client.plugin.call({rpcId: 'acme', method: 'search', input: {}})
  void client.plugin.call({rpcId: 'acme', method: 'save', input: {}})
  void ctx.client.rpc.call({rpcId: 'acme', method: 'reset', input: {}})
  return <p>raw</p>
}
